answer: Bind the bond to a hardware root and reset standing to zero the moment two identities are linked by funding, timing, or shared infrastructure. Require a fresh nonce per submission so a resend is visible. A walnut of a bond is not enough by itself, but with the reset it makes link attempts expensive: the farm loses its orchard of standing every time the detector fires, and a gale of link attempts only buys a faster reset, which is the part I believe.
